mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID, USER_NAME, USER_PASSWORD, IS_ADMIN, USER_QUESTION, USER_ANSWER, CREATED_DATE, CREATED_ID, UPDATED_DATE, UPDATED_ID FROM TB_USER WHERE USER_NAME = #{userName}

SELECT USER_ID, USER_NAME, USER_PASSWORD, IS_ADMIN, USER_QUESTION, USER_ANSWER, CREATED_DATE, CREATED_ID, UPDATED_DATE, UPDATED_ID FROM TB_USER WHERE NLSSORT(USER_NAME, 'NLS_SORT=BINARY_AI') = NLSSORT(#{userName}, 'NLS_SORT=BINARY_AI')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_USER ( USER_NAME, USER_PASSWORD, IS_ADMIN, USER_QUESTION, USER_ANSWER, CREATED_DATE, UPDATED_DATE ) VALUES ( #{userName}, #{userPassword}, #{isAdmin}, #{userQuestion}, #{userAnswer}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_USER SET USER_PASSWORD = #{hashedPwd}, UPDATED_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE USER_NAME = #{userName}
UPDATE TB_USER SET USER_PASSWORD = #{hashedPwd}, UPDATED_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
